Nora P: Hi all, Nora here (new SDR). HR done but Im blocked: HubSpot shows "no access", Dialpad asks to claim an extension but the claim button is greyed out, and I can't find the SDR playbook. Who owns these?
Zack (Sales Ops): Welcome Nora! Tagging myself. Can you confirm your exact work email and manager?
Nora P: nora.p@redwood.ai, manager: Mina. Thanks!
Zack (Sales Ops): Cool. Submitting provisioning. Short payload I sent IT:```Name: Nora P
Email: nora.p@redwood.ai
Manager: Mina (Sales Enablement)
Role: SDR
Access: HubSpot (Sales), Dialpad extension, Gong (listener)
Notes: needs SDR playbook + sandbox account```
ProvisionBot: Provisioning ticket created by Zack (Sales Ops). Ticket RB-20260325-77. ETA 20-45 mins.
Mina (Sales Enablement): Nora  welcome! SDR playbook link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/sales/sdr-playbook. Also youre added to #sdr-cohort and the week-1 checklist is pinned there.
Nora P: Thanks! Quick Q: where are the outbound email templates and the call framework?
Mina (Sales Enablement): Email templates -> Confluence > Templates > SDR Emails. Call framework is the "3-bucket discovery" doc in the playbook. Ill paste 2 cold-open snippets in #sales-resources.
Riley (CS): For Gong, you'll be set as a listener so you can see calls. Once you have Gong, enable highlights sharing so mentors can review.
Zack (Sales Ops): Update: HubSpot seat provisioned, invite sent. Dialpad claim fixed (you should see ext 1402). Gong invite emailed (check promotions/spam). Sandbox account created: sdr-nora@redwood-sandbox.io  credentials emailed.
Nora P: Got HubSpot and Dialpad (ext 1402) - Dialpad test call succeeded. Still waiting on Gong.
Zack (Sales Ops): Gong invite resent. If not in inbox, use one-time accept link: https://gong.accept.link/sdr. Ping me if that fails.
Mina (Sales Enablement): Also scheduled a 30-min ramp with a top SDR today at 3pm PT. Bring one cold email and one cold call script to the sync.
Nora P: Will do. One last: where do I log prospect lists and sequences? HubSpot or Notion?
Mina (Sales Enablement): Prospect lists live in HubSpot (Lists > SDR > Team Lists). Sequence templates are HubSpot Sequences under "SDR Templates". We keep research notes in Notion -> Sales Research.
Nora P: Brilliant. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
Zack (Sales Ops): Closing RB-20260325-77 once Gong is confirmed. Reopen if anything breaks.
